and notices of Federal agencies and organizations, as well as executive orders and other presidential documents. The Federal Register is published by the Office of Federal Register, National Archives and Records Administration (NARA). The following notices have been published in the Federal Register by AmeriCorps. To review the complete text of the following notices, please visit the GPO website . summary: AmeriCorps publishes Federal Register notices to inform the public about rules, proposed rules, and agency updates. These notices target stakeholders such as grantees, volunteers, and program participants. Key deadlines include public comment periods, typically lasting 60 days, for forms and proposed rules. Recent focus areas include childcare benefits, Schools of National Service, and AmeriCorps Seniors initiatives.
